project_name.justification: CanAlaska is pleased to announce it has signed a Property Swap Agreement (the "Agreement") with F3 Uranium Corp. ("F3 Uranium") dated January 16, 2024 for the acquisition of the Nebula Project (the "Nebula Project") in the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan

company_name.justification: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. (TSXV: CVV) (OTCQX: CVVUF) (FSE: DH7)("CanAlaska" or the "Company") is pleased to announce it has signed a Property Swap Agreement (the "Agreement") with F3 Uranium Corp. ("F3 Uranium") dated January 16, 2024 for the acquisition of the Nebula Project

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Under the same agreement, F3 Uranium agreed to sell its 100% ownership in the 37 mineral claims comprising the Nebula Project to CanAlaska in consideration for the Patterson West Property...

primary_commodity.justification: The Nebula Project deal provides CanAlaska with 100% ownership in an area with historical exploration which has already identified several significant uranium occurrences including the large Karpinka Lake Uranium Boulder train.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is a press release from CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. announcing the acquisition of the Nebula Project.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, CanAlaska Uranium Ltd., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: CVV), a Canadian exchange, implying CAD. The only monetary value mentioned is for a potential NSR buy-back: '...permitting CanAlaska to purchase 40% of the NSR royalty (being a 1% NSR royalty) for $3,000,000.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is a 'Property Swap Agreement' where CanAlaska exchanged its Patterson West Property for the Nebula Project. No cash consideration was part of the primary transaction.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is a 'Property Swap Agreement'. No shares were issued as part of the consideration.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction is a 'Property Swap Agreement'. No combined cash and share value was mentioned.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction is a 'Property Swap Agreement'. No shares were issued as part of the consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned in the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned in the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issued share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters was mentioned in the article.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No specific exploration expenditure commitment was mentioned as part of the agreement. The text only states: 'Initial work by CanAlaska is expected to include property wide compilation of all historical data to generate further target areas for immediate exploration and drilling follow-up.'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller, F3 Uranium, retained a royalty as part of the transaction: 'F3 Uranium agreed to sell its 100% ownership in the 37 mineral claims comprising the Nebula Project to CanAlaska in consideration for the Patterson West Property and a 2.5% NSR royalty over the Nebula Project...'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The Nebula Project, formerly known as F3 Uranium's Hobo Lake Property, is located in the southeastern Athabasca Basin and covers 14,854 hectares.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Nebula Project, formerly known as F3 Uranium's Hobo Lake Property, is located in the southeastern Athabasca Basin and covers 14,854 hectares.

resource_size.justification: The article does not contain a mineral resource estimate for the Nebula project. It mentions historical exploration results such as '111 radioactive boulders, 81 of which returned grab sample results containing up to 0.39% U3O8' and a '40 metre wide strongly graphitic, chlorite and clay altered fault zone', but these are not resource statements of mass or volume.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified in the text as 'CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. (TSXV: CVV) (OTCQX: CVVUF) (FSE: DH7)'.
